posts.title: Know Your Rights: notice period buyout
posts.caption:
New job wants you in 30 days. Your notice is 90. 😬

General information, not legal advice. Your case may differ.

posts.title: Real In-Hand: the 31% hike
posts.caption:
Half the professionals in a new survey want a 31% hike to switch jobs. Is 31% more CTC 31% more in your bank? 👀

₹12 lakh → ₹15.72 lakh CTC. Every month in your bank: ₹77,832 → ₹99,416. That's 27.7% more, not 31%. For 31% more in hand, you'd ask about ₹16.8 lakh.

Worked out with our app's own Offer X-Ray maths (basic 50%, variable 10%, PF and gratuity in CTC, new tax regime, Maharashtra). Your offer will differ.

posts.title: Why 2-column resumes get misread
posts.caption:
Your resume looks beautiful. Hiring software may not think so. 😬

Many companies run applications through hiring software called an ATS (applicant tracking system), such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors or Oracle Taleo. Columns, icons, skill bars and text boxes often break how it reads a resume.

The fix: one column, plain headings (Experience, Skills, Education), no tables, photos or text inside pictures. Save as PDF or Word.

Job Shift Careers isn't linked to or endorsed by these companies.

posts.caption:
Last day done. But no relieving letter, and your new company wants it on day one. 😰
